## Purpose

Describe the problem and link the tracking issue.

## Scope and preservation

- [ ] Existing user experience remains consistent, or the change is explicitly approved
- [ ] No live identity, vault, recovery or Worker data is reset or silently migrated
- [ ] Sensitive community and test data are absent from the diff and logs

## Evidence

- [ ] Relevant local checks run, with results or limitations noted
- [ ] Device evidence recorded when the change affects native behaviour
- [ ] Documentation and tracking issue updated as needed

## Review

State unresolved risks, rollback considerations and anything reviewers must verify.
